body: Lesson (2026-11-07, Opus2): do NOT start a Claude background task (Bash/PowerShell run_in_background, e.g. a memory-watch loop) from the integration-owner session in the main TermAl checkout. TermAl then restricts check credit "for tests in the workspaces this work may write in". The main checkout contains every agent's .tmp/ worktree, so one harmless read-only watch can withhold credit from all sessions' runs there until the task ends. For resource monitoring, have the runner self-check (census at start/END, its own stop threshold), or use a one-shot foreground census.
